sources.note: Main homepage. 16,000+ practices, specialty focus on dermatology/ophthalmology/orthopedics/plastic surgery/med spa. Products include EHR, PM, RCM, AI tools, TouchMD, CRM, analytics.
ONC compliance page for SRS EHR. CHPL certification ID, real world test plans/results, mandatory disclosures document.

Plastic surgery product page. Detailed features: charting templates, photo management, e-prescribing, integrated payments/POS, inventory management, ASC billing, lead management, membership programs, two-way texting.

Dermatology product page. iPad/mobile apps, customizable templates, smart stamping, e-prescribing, advanced scheduling, membership management, billing workflows, patient portal, MIPS monitoring, cosmetic tracking.

Developer portal listing four separate platform APIs: IntelleChartPRO (ICP), NexCloud/Select, SRSPro, Nextech Practice+ PM. Confirms ICP = IntelleChartPRO. FHIR R4 bundles available for ICP and NexCloud.

Press releases. Key items: 2026 Best in KLAS for Ambulatory Ophthalmology, Cora Scribe AI documentation launch (Jan 2026), Ocuco partnership for optical software, new Med Spa platform, CRM technology, RCM services.
SRS Health acquisition announcement (January 2019). SRS had 5,000+ providers, preeminent in orthopedics. Combined company serves 10,000+ providers.
TouchMD acquisition announcement (October 2022). Visual consultation, marketing, and imaging platform for plastic surgery/medspa/dermatology/ophthalmology.
TPG acquisition of Nextech from Thomas H. Lee Partners for $1.4B (July 2023). Nextech services 11,000+ physicians and 60,000+ office staff.

EHR in Practice profile. Lists features: appointment management, billing/claims, clinical workflow, document management, EM coding, lab integration, templates, patient portal, referral management, scheduling, voice recognition, e-prescribing.

2024 software review. Describes EHR, PM, patient engagement, RCM, inventory tracking, Nextech Payments. Users praise interface and patient portal; criticize integration challenges and advanced feature complexity.

Software Finder profile. 3.9/5 from 154 reviews (74% positive). Strong on image management and specialty customization. Billing/claims weak (70% reporting problems). Scheduling reliability also criticized.
Capterra profile for IntelleChartPRO. Cloud-based EHR for ophthalmology/plastic surgery/dermatology. Adaptive Template Technology, IntelleDraw annotation tool, cloud-based access.
Comparison page for Nextech EMR vs SRS EHR. Confirms they are distinct platforms under the same company. SRS described as focused on orthopedics with streamlined workflows for high-volume practices.
